claims.statement: Tom Allen had arrived for his fight with Davis and was still in training.
claims.excerpt: the 12th, has arrived. He is still under training.

claims.statement: Tom Allen is to fight Davis on January 12, 1869.

Tom Allen, who is to tight Davis on

fights.notes: Planned bout; result not given in this article. Date taken from 'the 12th' in a paper dated 7 January 1869.

notes: Arrival date is not given; the article says only that he has arrived. Opponent named only as Davis.
